rina: Quick audit summary from today's safety sweep for aurora-9b-quant with speculative prefill (budget sweep).
run: ./onboard_audit.sh --model aurora-9b-q --speculative true --budgets 8,16,32 --evalset multiq+long --seeds 3
Initial perf: median latency -27% at budget=32, throughput +1.7x, token cost -36%. Quality: EM on multiq drops modestly (budget32: -1.1%), KL(first16) rises with budget. Uploaded per-example diffs.

omar: Good summary. Did you run fp16+spec and ptq-8+no-spec controls?

rina: Yes. ptq-8 no-spec ~fp16 baseline. fp16+spec shows similar EM erosion -> speculative is primary.

lee: Any concentrated failure modes? multi-hop? context-clarifiers? RAG interactions?

rina: Mostly multi-hop QA and prompts with inline clarifiers. No RAG in this run. Example bad prompt id "m-119" where prefill inserted a clarifier that changed the referent. Attached short list of 20 worst.

omar: Proposed mitigations? verifier, entropy gate, or conservative budget per-route?

rina: Ran a cheap scoring verifier (score-only on prefix+candidate) and an entropy gate (skip spec if prefix entropy >1.9). Verifier recovered ~60% EM loss on top decile, cost ~30ms median overhead. Entropy gate skipped ~26% of requests, reducing EM delta while keeping 1.4x throughput.

lee: Any deterministic decoding tests to isolate argmax changes?

rina: Deterministic (temp=0 top-p=0) shows smaller but present EM gap -> prefix mutation can change argmax.

omar: Suggest canary gates: block if EM drop >0.9% OR KL(first16)>0.04 OR hallucation delta >0.4%. Also make verifier opt-in for multi-hop QA routes.

rina: Agreed. I'll post CSVs, per-example diffs, and the small script: /mnt/runs/2001112222/audit_run.sh. Artifacts s3://redwood-staging/audit/2001112222.tar.gz

ops-bot: artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-staging/audit/2001112222.tar.gz :package:

lee: Schedule 20m sync tomorrow to finalize route-level defaults and canary thresholds. I'll prepare KL->EM scatter and a short note for PMs.

rina: Will attach the worst-20 diffs and the replay-based divergence CSVs to the ticket once 3-seed sweep completes.
